title: Regular Decision, Fall 2027 Admission
about: Georgetown University in Qatar is accepting Regular Decision applications for Fall 2027 undergraduate admission until January 15, 2027, through the Common App or its own application. Regular Decision applicants are notified by April 1, 2027.
requirements: Apply through the Common App or the GU-Q application
card_alt: Card for Regular Decision, Fall 2027 Admission at Georgetown University in Qatar (GU-Q), Doha, Qatar, with a 15 Jan 2027 deadline. The photo shows the crescent-shaped Katara Towers in Lusail, north of Doha, at dusk.
